description: Get push notification readiness: whether web push is enabled (with its VAPID public key), whether APNs (iOS) and Firebase (Android) credentials are connected, the last credential error for each, and active device counts per platform. Check this before creating push campaigns or push sequence steps.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_push_settings

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_push_settings` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

push.description: Push readiness: web (enabled, vapidPublicKey), ios (configured, keyId, teamId, bundleId, environment, lastError), android (configured, projectId, clientEmail, lastError), defaultIconUrl, brandIconUrl (company logo used when defaultIconUrl is null), devices (active counts per platform, identifiedActive, totalActive, permissions: iOS/Android devices by reported notification permission (granted, provisional, ephemeral, denied, notDetermined, unknown) and optInRate 0-1 or null)).

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
